Name: Integrate Stripe Subscription Tiers
Description: Owner: Taylor and Jordan. Set up three subscription tiers (Basic at $29/month, Pro at $49/month, Enterprise at $99/month) in Stripe and integrate them into the app ensuring correct functionality and seamless user experience. Deadline: within two weeks from meeting date. Acceptance criteria: All tiers available in Stripe and accurately reflected in the app's pricing page and checkout process.

Name: Develop Frontend Checkout and Pricing Page
Description: Owner: Jordan. Implement Stripe Elements for the checkout form with customizable, secure design matching app style. Include clear feature comparison for each subscription tier, prominent checkout button, and tooltip explaining plan changes. Update pricing page to show new subscription tiers. Deadline: within two weeks. Acceptance criteria: Checkout form fully functional, styled, and error handling for invalid card details and insufficient funds implemented.

Name: Build User Dashboard Subscription Features
Description: Owner: Jordan. Develop dashboard features to display current plan details and billing info, allow upgrade/downgrade/cancel subscription, access invoices and payment history, and update payment methods. Dashboard should update subscription status in real-time and notify users of changes such as successful upgrades or payment failures. Deadline: coordinated with frontend integration timeline. Acceptance criteria: Dashboard reflects subscription status dynamically and provides clear notifications.

Name: Integrate Stripe API and Webhook Handlers
Description: Owner: Taylor. Implement backend integration with Stripe API to manage subscriptions, process payments, and handle webhook events including invoice.payment_succeeded, invoice.payment_failed (with user email notifications), and customer.subscription.deleted. Set up webhook handlers to update system correctly and test thoroughly with scenarios simulating payment failures and cancellations. Deadline: within two weeks. Acceptance criteria: Backend correctly processes subscription lifecycle events and updates system state as expected.

Name: Coordinate Frontend-Backend Integration and Error Handling
Description: Owners: Jordan and Taylor. Jordan to integrate frontend with backend API ensuring real-time subscription updates on dashboard. Both to handle integration errors and provide clear user notifications for payment failures with instructions to resolve. Deadline: within two weeks, with one week dedicated to testing. Acceptance criteria: End-to-end subscription flow functions without errors, with clear notifications on failures.

Name: Prepare and Execute Test Plan for Subscription Flow
Description: Owner: Taylor. Develop detailed test plan covering manual and automated tests for full subscription lifecycle including sign-up, billing, upgrades/downgrades, cancellations, and error cases. Share test plan with team and execute testing during the week following initial integration. Acceptance criteria: All edge cases tested and verified for correct behavior.

Name: Create User Documentation and Support Resources
Description: Owners: Alex, Jordan, and Taylor. Prepare user-facing documentation with instructions on managing subscriptions, accessing invoices, and handling issues. Develop help section or FAQ for common subscription questions. Taylor to document API endpoints and webhook handlers for maintenance. Deadline: post-integration and testing phases. Acceptance criteria: Clear, accessible documentation and support materials available to users and developers.

Name: Schedule Follow-up Meeting
Description: Owner: Alex. Arrange a follow-up meeting next week to review progress and address any issues. Encourage team members to report blockers or ask for help as needed. Acceptance criteria: Meeting scheduled and conducted with status updates from all team members.
